inlines.value: category control the arrangement and style of block captions globally. Many of these keys can be customized
category, each of the keys listed in
keys, can be set on the caption key nested inside the following block categories:
For example, to configure the caption just for code blocks, use the following declaration:

code:
  caption:
    background-color: #FF0000
    font-color: #FFFFFF
    font-size: 1em
    font-style: bold
If a key is not specified on a block category, the key from the global
category will be used as a fallback.
